checkedAlternates.risk: Most NATO members are European countries.
checkedAlternates.resolution: NATO is a transatlantic collective-defense military alliance including the US and Canada (group-2), not a European economic/border union (group-3).

checkedAlternates.risk: OPEC coordinates global oil policy across regions.
checkedAlternates.resolution: OPEC is a single-commodity petroleum producers’ organization (group-1), not a multi-sector regional trade bloc (group-4).
